output.reason: The evidence supports that (a) “foreclosure” is defined as pre-payment of the loan in full, and (b) under the loan terms, in the event of foreclosure or pre-payment “in full or in part,” the borrower pays a pre-payment charge of 2% of the principal outstanding.
